t: Founded in 1967 when the National Liberation Front took power in Aden as British rule in southern Arabia ended.
The only Marxist–Leninist state in the Arab world, ruled by the Yemeni Socialist Party and allied with the Soviet Union.
A party civil war in 1986 and the end of Soviet support led to unification with North Yemen on 22 May 1990.
dyk: South Yemen’s Family Law of 1974 restricted polygamy and set a minimum age of marriage, making it one of the most progressive family codes in the Arab world.
ev: The NLF begins its armed uprising in the Radfan mountains
Britain withdraws and the People’s Republic of South Yemen is proclaimed on 30 November
The Corrective Move removes President Qahtan al-Shaabi
The country is renamed the People’s Democratic Republic of Yemen
The Yemeni Socialist Party is founded
Border war with North Yemen; treaty of friendship with the Soviet Union
Party civil war in Aden kills thousands, including Abdul Fattah Ismail
Unification with North Yemen forms the Republic of Yemen on 22 May
